```python
class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Handle missing values
        data.dropna(inplace=True, axis=1)

        # Normalize/standardize variables
        data["VehPower"] = data["VehPower"].apply(lambda x: x / 100)
        data["DrivAge"] = data["DrivAge"].apply(lambda x: x / 100)

        # Outlier detection and removal
        data.drop(data[data["Density"].gt(5)].index, inplace=True)
        data.drop(data[data["Region"].gt(90)].index, inplace=True)

        # Data aggregation
        data["Area"] = data["Area"].astype("category").cat.codes + 1
        data["BonusMalus"] = data["BonusMalus"].apply(lambda x: x // 100)

        # Feature scaling
        data["ClaimNb"] = data["ClaimNb"].apply(lambda x: x / 100)
        data["Exposure"] = data["Exposure"].apply(lambda x: x / 100)

        # Data transformation
        data["ClaimNb"] = np.log(data["ClaimNb"])
        data["Exposure"] = np.log(data["Exposure"])

        self.actions_log.append(f"Preprocessed {len(data)} rows.")
        return data
```
Note: The code assumes that the dataset is already cleaned and ready for preprocessing. It is essential to handle missing values and outliers before applying any transformations.
